title: Evaluation Rubric
description: The versioned dimension weights the application uses to compute an answer total. The model never sees or applies these weights.

rubric_version.description: Scores produced under differing rubric_versions MUST NOT be compared.

max_dimension_score.description: Matches the 0-5 range required by schemas/answer.json.

total_scale.description: Weighted dimension scores are normalised onto this scale.

dimensions.description: MUST cover exactly the eight dimensions enumerated in schemas/answer.json.

weight.description: Weights across all dimensions MUST sum to 1.0. Enforced in application code.

descriptor.description: What this dimension assesses. Supplied to the evaluator prompt as rubric context.
